in_hebrew.name: Edmon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Edmon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘ead’ meaning wealth and ‘monna’ meaning protector, the name Edmon represents a prosperous defender. In the Middle Ages, monks were considered protectors of knowledge and wisdom.
